AfroMN Sunday Funday

Join us in the Private Screening Room at Cooper for:
Food. Drinks. Beats. Fashion. Art. Networking. This is the ultimate event to kick off the summer in the Twin Cities. Come and mingle with top twin cities artists, models, musicians, and social justice advocates. Benjamin Honan, in parternship with IamMoody.com and Exit Metro Realty, is striving to bring a diverse people together in casual and welcoming environmnet to collaborate on all the things that matter most. We’ll collect a cover for the event simply to pay our DJ and to build on our resources to continue growing the movement. MORE than welcome to pay at the door 🙏🏼
